title: Object storage: S3 vs Cloud Storage vs Azure Blob
intro: Standard / Hot tier, single US region, list prices. Per GB-month stored, per GB out to the internet, and per 1,000 requests. Read 10 Oct 2026.

items.title: AWS S3 Standard
items.description: Storage $0.023 per GB-month (first 50 TB). Egress $0.09 per GB. Requests $0.005 per 1,000 puts, $0.0004 per 1,000 gets. Uptime commitment 99.9%.

items.title: Google Cloud Storage Standard
items.description: Storage $0.020 per GB-month. Egress $0.12 per GB. Requests $0.005 per 1,000 Class A, $0.0004 per 1,000 Class B. Uptime commitment 99.9% regional, 99.95% multi-region.

items.title: Azure Blob Hot
items.description: Storage $0.0208 per GB-month (first 50 TB). Egress $0.087 per GB. Requests $0.005 per 1,000 writes, $0.0004 per 1,000 reads. Uptime commitment 99.9%, 99.99% on RA-GRS reads.

sections.text: Best pick for a low-bandwidth media archive

items.title: Google Cloud Storage Standard
items.description: Cheapest storage of the three at $0.020 per GB-month, and an archive that is barely read pays almost nothing but storage. 1 TB archived costs $20.48 a month, against $21.30 on Azure and $23.55 on AWS. No minimum storage duration and no retrieval fee. Its $0.12 per GB egress is the highest here, so keep any bulk re-download off the critical path.

closing: Storage decides it: GCS $20.48, Azure $21.30, AWS $23.55 per TB-month. Request costs are identical, so they break no tie.
